question: What Is the Dress Code at Beauty & Essex Las Vegas?
quick_answer: Beauty & Essex Las Vegas lists its dress code as smart casual: think a nice shirt or blouse, dark jeans or slacks and clean shoes, not gym clothes, swimwear or flip-flops. It's inside The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas, in the Boulevard Tower, and you enter through a real pawn shop. Dinner runs 5 to 10:30 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and 5 to 11:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday. Reservations are recommended, especially on weekends.
key_facts: Entrance through a working pawn shop

body.heading: The dress code
body.text: Beauty & Essex's official listing on OpenTable gives the dress code as smart casual. In practice, that means dressing like you're going out for a nice dinner: a collared shirt, blouse, dress or nice top, with jeans or slacks and clean shoes. It's a dressy room on a Saturday night, and many guests, including birthday and bachelorette groups, dress up. Leave athletic wear, swimwear, tank tops and flip-flops at the hotel.

body.heading: Finding it and the pawn shop entrance
body.text: Beauty & Essex is inside The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas, at 3708 Las Vegas Blvd. South, in the Boulevard Tower. From the outside it looks like a pawn shop with guitars, jewelry and vintage goods in the cases, and it really does sell them. You walk through the shop to reach the restaurant behind it, which Rockwell Group designed to feel like a jewelry box, with mirrors and walls of framed vintage lockets.

body.heading: Hours and reservations
body.text: Listed dinner hours are 5 to 10:30 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and 5 to 11:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday. It's booked well over 100 times a day on OpenTable, so book ahead, especially for weekends and large groups. The bar is first come, first served and serves the full menu, which is the easiest way in without a reservation. The phone number is (702) 737-0707. A DJ plays later in the evening, and the room gets louder as the night goes on.

body.heading: What to order
body.text: The menu is built for sharing, with small plates, larger plates and steaks. The best-known dish is the grilled cheese and tomato soup dumplings, and tuna poke wonton tacos are another signature. Plan on two or three plates per person. Small plates run about $17 to $32 and cocktails about $20 to $24 on our latest check; see our Beauty & Essex Las Vegas menu for full prices.

body.heading: A little background
body.text: Beauty & Essex started on New York's Lower East Side in 2010 and came to Las Vegas in May 2016, run by Tao Group with chef Chris Santos. The 10,000-square-foot Vegas restaurant seats about 230 diners, plus about 90 more in the bar and lounge, and has private rooms for larger parties.

faqs.q: Does Beauty & Essex Las Vegas have a dress code?
faqs.a: Yes. It's listed as smart casual, so skip athletic wear, swimwear and flip-flops.

faqs.q: Can you wear jeans to Beauty & Essex Las Vegas?
faqs.a: Yes, nice jeans are generally fine with a dressier top and clean shoes.

faqs.q: Where is Beauty & Essex in Las Vegas?
faqs.a: Inside The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas, in the Boulevard Tower, behind a pawn shop storefront.

faqs.q: Is the pawn shop at Beauty & Essex real?
faqs.a: Yes. The storefront is a working pawn shop, and items like jewelry and guitars are for sale.

faqs.q: Do you need reservations for Beauty & Essex Las Vegas?
faqs.a: They're recommended. Bar seating is first come, first served.
